sourceManifestSelection: All git-tracked .ts and .json files under src, excluding filenames containing .test.; a conservative source input manifest, not a claim that every listed file executes.

method.exactHashMethod: SHA256 of JSON with sorted object keys; exact JSON numbers; array order preserved
method.commandsMethod: rolling SHA256 of nonempty actually issued command frames prefixed by iteration
method.cpuLimitValidation: Instrumented timing is diagnostic only; unchanged Vitest cold three-map CPU assertion is authoritative

timingLimits: Instrumented timings are a single diagnostic pair, not repeated statistical measurements. Vitest case durations are wall time, not CPU readings; unchanged three-map assertions provide CI budget validation.

fullSuiteEarlierFailure.reason: New SDK/AI integration fixture was placed in SDK directory; relocated under AI policy and package boundary checks retained.

scopeLimit: Exact equality is demonstrated for this bareDuel V2 36,000-tick diagnostic only, not every map or every match. Three-map CPU assertions and the full suite are separate validations.
